name: Kahn
summary: The company secretary, identified by Larry at right in VN-0003. Larry remembers that he "walked funny, stiff legged like he had polio."
larrysRecollection: Right: Kahn, company secretary, walked funny, stiff legged like he had polio. (VN-0003 Memories comment, 2026-08-13)
researchNotes: As company secretary he would appear throughout the unit's paperwork, making him a good anchor name for locating the unit's morning reports at NPRC once the unit itself is confirmed. The spelling is phonetic; Kahn, Khan, Conn, and Kohn are all candidates.
